scope: Static audit of current mobile block registration and implementations; no production Dart, data, logic or UI edits.
definition: A mixed block implementation means distinct registered node types routed through one concrete BlockComponentBuilder; shared bases, widgets/state for one block, attribute variants, inline objects and protected placeholders are separate categories.

actual_mixed_groups.evidence: Formal registry maps all three to this builder; _TableBlock.build branches for table and table-row, then renders cell UI.
actual_mixed_groups.plan: Retain table host and existing controls/grid; move row and cell branches to their own builders/widgets/files. Share children/empty-body handling and helpers. Preserve node tree, IDs, merge/layout metadata, renderer recursion, focus/selection and callback context.

actual_mixed_groups.evidence: Formal registry and _webTypes share one builder; native metadata vs WebView, labels/icons and size paths depend on node type.
actual_mixed_groups.priority: optional; intentionally grouped by earlier request
actual_mixed_groups.plan: Optional bookmark/web-embed/Juejin/Figma thin builders and view classes over shared resource selection/actions/preview helpers. Keep loaders, WebView/source keys, sizing, URL rules, menus and view-conversion semantics unchanged.

related_but_not_mixed_blocks.evidence: Adapter maps heading_1..heading_9 to the heading node type plus level; AppFlowy HeadingBlockComponentBuilder is already separate from paragraph/quote/list builders.
related_but_not_mixed_blocks.decision: Keep level as data; do not create nine independent block types or duplicate renderers.

related_but_not_mixed_blocks.evidence: Distinct AppFlowy builder files; collab paragraph/list helpers and alignment wrappers share operations across types.
related_but_not_mixed_blocks.decision: Already separated renderers. Shared editing/presentation is not a mixed block renderer; retain helpers.
Can optionally split presentation entry classes, but these are inline objects, not registered card blocks. Preserve that only meeting/task can convert to cards; lower priority.

related_but_not_mixed_blocks.evidence: Mermaid source is a unique formal Y.Text child consumed by its parent/editor sheet; image captions are displayed by image content.
related_but_not_mixed_blocks.decision: Keep parent/child contracts. Optional helper extraction is possible; do not add standalone renderers or new registration semantics.
Only link remains after image/video split. No mixed implementation; optional file/class/enum naming cleanup only.

related_but_not_mixed_blocks.category: Resource settings, shared bases, adapter, registry
related_but_not_mixed_blocks.decision: These are common forms/infrastructure/composition, not multiple card implementations. Preserve shared coordination in this class-only task.
Protects multiple unsupported types without implementing them; do not count placeholder wrappers as completed individual block implementations.

proposed_migration_constraints: No type/flavour, ID, schema, attributes or document projection changes.
Retain controller/WebView/loader ownership, source identity and asynchronous invalidation.
Only move class declarations/render branches and update precise imports/registration; keep shared code in explicit bases/helpers.
Any later implementation requires targeted/full package and consumer checks and source/render parity verification.

upstream_version.reason: Expected adjacent desktop repository checked before this audit and remains unavailable; configured registry, declaration/lock/install artifacts, packaged skills/MIGRATIONS and upstream implementation cannot be verified here.

verification: Read-only source/registration inspection. No Flutter tests were rerun because no Dart code changed; git diff --check run for audit documentation.
